full_judgment: 2. In the year 1980, the petitioner, as plaintiff, instituted in the Court of Sadar Munsif, now Assistant Judge, Rajshahi, a Suit being other class suit No. 275 of 1980, seeking permanent injunction restraining the defendant, now opposite party, from demolishing or dismantling the boundary wall described in the schedule to the plaint or causing any damage or change to the existing nature, character and feature of the same. The defendant contested the same by filing a written statement. The suit was, however, decreed in favour of the plaintiff. The defendant then took an appeal therefrom and the appellate Court allowed the appeal, set aside the decree and sent back the case to the trial Court for fresh disposal after holding a local investigation in respect of the disputed boundary wall.
